main.description: How one of the caller's own instances is performing: its scripts' runs, times and errors, and its record ingest, as HappyView reports them. Customers only.

view.description: scripts: every script, summarised. script: one script, named by trigger. ingest: the record-ingest stages. live: what is running now.

window.description: How far back to summarise. HappyView's default when absent.

trigger.description: The script, for view=script, and only then: its trigger id, `<kind>:<target>`, e.g. xrpc.query:games.example.listGames or record.create:app.bsky.feed.post.

metrics.description: HappyView's own report for the view, as it sent it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An id is not a UUID, or a view, window or trigger is missing, unknown or malformed.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance, or it is not the caller's. These are indistinguishable.

errors.name: MetricsUnavailable
errors.description: The instance's HappyView release predates metrics. Upgrading it fixes this.

errors.name: MetricsTimeout
errors.description: The instance didn't answer in time.

errors.name: NoRuns
errors.description: For view=script: the script hasn't run in this window.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
